I concede that clear legal pathways for migrants not only protect their rights but also contribute to a balanced immigration system that benefits the UK economy.
Tapered benefits might seem motivating, but they often trap people in low-wage jobs without addressing the root causes of inequality, weakening the economy in the long run.
I accept that a gradual reduction in benefits when you start earning is a smart way to keep people motivated without creating a cliff edge that discourages work.
